author: Ankit
problem: A ride has K seats and N groups wait in a queue, each with at most K people. Repeatedly: if the front group doesn't fit in the empty seats, the ride starts and all K seats are empty again; otherwise the group boards. When the queue is empty, the ride starts one last time. Print how many times the ride starts.
bug_description: The final start is counted whenever seats aren't 0, but seats are reset to K right after a ride that filled up exactly, so that start is counted twice.

comments.accurate: Simulates the boarding queue and counts how many times the ride starts
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts every start during boarding, then always one more for the final run once the queue is empty
comments.wrong_location: Final departure check verified; check the case where a group is bigger than the seats left
